import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from poolfit import *
from lib import labels
y=labels(); Y=np.eye(8)[y]
F=np.load('feats_seq1024.npz'); M9=F['mean_hidden_L9'].astype(np.float64); C9=F['cls_hidden_L9'].astype(np.float64)
c, cr, lam, c0, NA, t = 20.0, 1.0, 0.01, 0.25, 1008, 1.0
mu9=M9.mean(0); Z=pool_z(M9,C9,c,mu9,cr)
Zk=Z[:,KEEP]; Zn=Zk/np.linalg.norm(Zk,axis=1,keepdims=True); Kex=np.exp(Zn@Zn.T-1)
piv=pivchol(Kex,NA); Wd=anchor_dirs(Z[piv])
P=gelu(Z@Wd.T); Lr=Z[:,RES]; msq=(Lr-Lr.mean(0)).var(0).sum()
X=np.concatenate([P,Lr],1); pen=np.r_[lam*np.ones(NA), lam/c0*msq*np.ones(8)]
mu=X.mean(0); Xc=X-mu; Ym=Y.mean(0)
coef=np.linalg.solve(Xc.T@Xc+np.diag(pen), Xc.T@(Y-Ym)); b=Ym-mu@coef
S=X@coef+b; srt=np.sort(S,1); print('train acc', (S.argmax(1)==y).mean(), 'min margin', (srt[:,-1]-srt[:,-2]).min(), 'score range', S.min(), S.max())
coefP, coefL = coef[:NA], coef[NA:]
B=coefL-np.eye(8)
# --- layer 11 weights
P11='bert.encoder.layer.11.'
d=np.full(768,c); d[RES]=cr
save_edit(P11+'attention.self.query.weight', np.zeros((768,768),np.float32))
save_edit(P11+'attention.self.query.bias', np.zeros(768,np.float32))
save_edit(P11+'attention.self.value.weight', np.eye(768,dtype=np.float32))
save_edit(P11+'attention.self.value.bias', np.zeros(768,np.float32))
save_edit(P11+'attention.output.dense.weight', np.diag(d).astype(np.float32))
save_edit(P11+'attention.output.dense.bias', (-d*mu9).astype(np.float32))
save_edit(P11+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight', np.ones(768,np.float32))
save_edit(P11+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias', np.zeros(768,np.float32))
W1=np.zeros((3072,768)); W1[:NA]=Wd
for r in range(8):
    W1[NA+2*r, RES[r]]=t; W1[NA+2*r+1, RES[r]]=-t
W2=np.zeros((768,3072)); b2=np.zeros(768)
for k in range(8):
    W2[RES[k],:NA]=coefP[:,k]
    for r in range(8):
        W2[RES[k],NA+2*r]=B[r,k]/t; W2[RES[k],NA+2*r+1]=-B[r,k]/t
    b2[RES[k]]=b[k]
save_edit(P11+'intermediate.dense.weight', W1.astype(np.float32)); save_edit(P11+'intermediate.dense.bias', np.zeros(3072,np.float32))
save_edit(P11+'output.dense.weight', W2.astype(np.float32)); save_edit(P11+'output.dense.bias', b2.astype(np.float32))
save_edit(P11+'output.LayerNorm.weight', np.ones(768,np.float32)); save_edit(P11+'output.LayerNorm.bias', np.zeros(768,np.float32))
# --- numpy expectation of the model
A=gelu(Z@W1[:1024].T); u=Z+A@W2[:,:1024].T+b2; h=LN(u)
hr=h[:,RES]; hc=hr-hr.mean(1,keepdims=True)
print('u[RES] vs S max diff', np.abs(u[:,RES]-S).max(), 'hc range', hc.min(), hc.max())
sp_=2.5/np.abs(hc).max()
Wp=np.zeros((768,768)); 
for k in range(8):
    for r in range(8): Wp[k,RES[r]]=sp_*((k==r)-1/8)
save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.weight', Wp.astype(np.float32)); save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.bias', np.zeros(768,np.float32))
Wc=np.zeros((8,768)); Wc[np.arange(8),np.arange(8)]=1
save_edit('classifier.weight', Wc.astype(np.float32)); save_edit('classifier.bias', np.zeros(8,np.float32))
logits=np.tanh(sp_*hc)
np.save('pred_logits_pool1.npy', logits); np.save('pool1_piv.npy', piv)
print('pred acc', (logits.argmax(1)==y).mean(), 'tanh arg max', np.abs(sp_*hc).max())
keeps=json.load(open('keep_seq1024.json'))
fk={i:keeps[str(i)] for i in range(9)}; fk[11]=list(range(1024))
print(set_structure(layers=list(range(9))+[11], ffn_keep=fk))
